title: Shilo Village
start: Talk to Mosol Rei, who is outside of Shilo Village in the south part of Karamja.

items.t: 3 regular bones (can be obtained during quest by killing level 44–46 skeletal undead ones)
Can be bought from Jiminua's Jungle Store (the general store north-west of Tai Bwo Wannai):
A chisel (the tool belt will not work for certain parts)
A torch (or any other light source, such as a lantern can be used, but be aware that you WILL lose this item)

recommended.t: An active Karamja lodestone, juju teleport spiritbags, dramen staff, spirit graahks, and Tai Bwo Wannai Teleport for teleportation around Karamja.
A salve amulet or salve amulet (e)
An antipoison (in case you are poisoned by a wandering warrior)

kills.t: Nazastarool (Level 53) (First appears as a zombie, then as a skeleton, and finally as a ghost)

rewards.t: Access to Precious gem rocks in Shilo Village
Access to the Shilo Village cart system, which travels between Brimhaven and Shilo Village for a fare of 10 coins

After completing the quest, you can sell every item you obtained during the quest to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village for 2000 coins — 100 coins each for the stone-plaque, tattered scroll, crumpled scroll, Bervirius notes and the bone key, 500 coins for the locating crystal, and 1000 coins for the beads of the dead.

steps.t: Teleport to Karamja (shortest teleport is CKR) and run far south/southeast to the southeast corner of Shilo Village.
Speak to Mosol Rei near the Broken cart. [Chat: 1 Why do I need to run? › 1 Rashiliyia? Who is she? › 1 What can we do? › 4 I'll go see the Shaman. › Accept] He will give you a wampum belt.
Teleport to the Karamja lodestone and run southeast to Trufitus, northeast of Tai Bwo Wannai Village, west of the hardwood grove.

Use the belt on Trufitus. Tell him you're going to search for "Ah Za Rhoon". [Chat: 2 Mosol Rei said something about a legend? › 1 Why was it called Ah Za Rhoon? › 3 I am going to search for Ah Za Rhoon! › 1 Yes, I will seriously look for Ah Za Rhoon and I'd appreciate your help.]

sub.t: If you don't yet have a chisel, a rope and torch, you should get those now from Jiminua's Jungle Store. You may also craft bronze wire at the nearby anvil.

steps.t: Travel east of Trufitus' hut, cross a wooden log and then head south to the mound of earth surrounded by three dead trees, Ah Za Rhoon.
Search the mound of earth and select excavate. [Chat: 1 Try to excavate the mound.]
Use a lit torch on the fissure.

sub.t: To obtain a lit torch, light the torch in the backpack.

steps.t: Use a rope on the fissure.
Search the fissure, climb down. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll give it a go!]
Search the cave in (see map) and wiggle through the rocks to proceed to the second area. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll wriggle through.]

After wiggling through, follow along the west side of the wall and search the loose rocks against the northwestern wall for a tattered scroll. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll carefully move the rocks to see what's behind them.]

sub.t: You might fail and take damage, retry until you succeed.

p: The location of the strange looking stone

steps.t: Search the old sacks in the far southeast corner for a crumpled scroll.
Search the ancient gallows to the north for the Zadimus corpse. [Chat: 2 Yes, I may find something else on the corpse.]
Read the scroll. [Chat: 1 Yes please.]
Use the Karamja lodestone/Tai Bwo Wannai teleport to get back to Trufitus.
Use the tattered scroll and crumpled scroll on Trufitus.
Use the Zadimus corpse on Trufitus.
Ask about the sacred ground. [Chat: 1 Is there any sacred ground around here?]
Walk west to the nearby Tribal Statue. Bury the corpse then talk to the Spirit of Zadimus for the bone shard.
p: The burial place of Zadimus' corpse.

steps.t: Use the bone shard on Trufitus. [Chat: 1 It appeared when I buried Zadimus' corpse. › 1 He said something after he gave it to me. › 1 The spirit said something about keys and kin?]
Talk to Trufitus. [Chat: 2 I need help with Bervirius.] Ensure Trufitus mentions the need to find the Tomb of Bervirius.
Head southwest to Cairn Isle by climbing the rocks and going across the bridge. Be careful, you can sometimes fall - use the Surge ability to bypass this.
Search the well stacked rocks to the north to enter the Tomb of Bervirius. If you fail search again until you are able to enter. [Chat: 1 Yes please, I can think of nothing nicer!]
Inside, run south and search the tomb dolmen to receive three items: sword pommel, locating crystal, and Bervirius notes.

sub.t: If you do not have enough space the notes will drop on the ground.

steps.t: Read all 3 options on the Bervirius notes.
Use the chisel on the sword pommel to create bone beads (the chisel on the tool belt will not work).
Use the bone beads on the bronze wire to create beads of the dead.

sub.t: You can make the bronze wire from a bronze bar at an anvil near Trufitus.

steps.t: Travel east of Trufitus' hut, over the agility log and run north, to the general area of The Shaikahan. (Fairy ring: DKP)
Search the foliage, then attempt to open the Ancient Door. (See the map for the location.)
Use a chisel on the bone shard.
Equip the beads of the dead.
Use the bone key on the door to open it.
Open the ancient metal gate.
Climb down the rock.
Run to the south west corner and use 3 bones on the tomb doors. Be careful not to bury them instead.
Open the doors and search the tomb dolmen.
Kill all 3 forms of Nazastarool. The stalagmites to the east of the tomb dolmen can be used as a safe spot.
p: Fighting the three forms of Nazastarool, from left to right: zombie, skeleton, and ghost.

steps.t: Search the tomb dolmen again for a Rashiliyia corpse.
Travel back to the Tomb of Bervirius on Cairn Isle.
Use the Rashiliyia corpse on the tomb dolmen.
Quest complete!

p: Undead ones appearing while talking to Mosol Rei.

get_inside.text: Walking to the Shilo Village gate from the Karamja lodestone.
pic: Walking to the Shilo Village gate from the Karamja lodestone.

get_inside.text: Shilo Village has two entrances: the gate to the east by using the right-click "Enter-village" option with Mosol Rei, and a tunnel shortcut under the northern wall (requiring completion of the Elite Karamja achievements and level 74 Agility, which is boostable).
Two items, the Slayer cape (by teleporting to Duradel/Lapalok) and the Karamja gloves 3, teleport directly to inside the village.

This method involves the most walking, but it requires no items nor quests completed to reach the gate. Head a short distance south-east from the Karamja lodestone until you reach the musician, then head a long way south, passing west of Tai Bwo Wannai. Keep going parallel to Karamja's west coast until you reach a small bay, then go south-southeast, around Cairn Isle, and then south past the bridge. Go a short distance southeast until you see another musician, then go east along Shilo Village's south wall until you reach the eastern gate.

Players who have completed the Shilo Village quest may use the Shilo Village cart system, which is run by Hajedy in Brimhaven. For a price of 10 coins, he will take the player to Vigroy in Shilo Village. The reverse trip is also possible. This makes it easy for the player to access Shilo Village if they first use the Catherby lodestone, then travel by ship to Brimhaven or teleport to the Karamja lodestone and then walk north until they get to the fruit tree patch and then east. Alternatively, if the player has planted a Spirit tree in the patch in Brimhaven, they could just walk north-west of it to reach the cart.

Karamja gloves 3 provide unlimited free teleports to the underground part of the Shilo Village mine. This can also be used to reach Brimhaven by taking Vigroy's cart from the south western corner of the village.
The Slayer Cape can be used to teleport directly to Duradel (or Lapalok after While Guthix Sleeps), in the north eastern section of the village.

The fairy ring CKR, south of Tai Bwo Wannai, can be used to reach Shilo Village, but you will have to walk around the south and enter by the east gate if you don't have the agility level and achievements to use the northern tunnel shortcut.

The fairy ring CJS within the Kharazi Jungle (requires partial completion of both A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen and Legends' Quest as well as 5 bittercap mushrooms in order to repair the ring if not already done). After teleporting, run west and exit the jungle north to reach Shilo Village.

Take a gnome glider to the Gandius location (requires completion of The Grand Tree quest) and run west past the overgrown idol and then south until you reach the waterfall with stepping stones which you must cross. After successfully crossing the stones, run directly west to the broken cart and cross to enter the village.
